requirement_table.text: Register ID at 0x000 reads 0x20940001.
Register BUILD at 0x004 reads the USR_ACCESSE2 word.
SCRATCH at 0x008 resets to 0.
SCRATCH at 0x008 reads back the last value written.
Unmapped addresses read 0.
Writes to unmapped addresses change no register.
h_rdata shows the addressed register within 2 clk_bus cycles of h_re.
h_rdata holds its value until the next h_re.
Each output equals saturate16((sum of h[k]*x[n-k] + 0x4000) >>> 15) bit for bit against the Python model.
The sum is exact with no intermediate rounding.
Samples before the first one are 0.
The impulse input gives the coefficient sequence as output.
The step input matches the model.
10,000 random samples sent in chunks of 1,000 without CLEAR match the model.
The datapath uses 16 multipliers by pre-adding symmetric taps.
The datapath multipliers are mapped to DSP48E2 slices.
The datapath accepts one sample per clk_dsp cycle.
clk_dsp is 250 MHz or faster with WNS of 0 ns or more after route.
The build report lists the DSP slices used.
The build report lists the clk_dsp frequency met.
The input FIFO holds 1,024 samples.
IN_PUSH on a full input FIFO is ignored.
The output FIFO holds 1,024 samples.
RUN processes the input FIFO samples in order into the output FIFO.
Filter history persists across RUN commands until CLEAR.
Chunked runs give the same outputs as one run.
OUT_POP on a non-empty FIFO reads bit 31 = 1 and bits 15:0 = the oldest output.
An OUT_POP read removes the oldest output from the FIFO.
OUT_POP on an empty output FIFO reads 0.
STATUS bit 0 is 1 while a RUN is in progress.
STATUS bits 15:4 give the input FIFO count from 0 to 1,024.
STATUS bits 31:20 give the output FIFO count.
CLEAR empties both FIFOs.
CLEAR zeroes the filter history.
CLEAR zeroes SAT_COUNT.
CLEAR zeroes SAMPLES_DONE.
CTRL bit 0 self-clears one clock after the write.
CTRL bit 1 self-clears one clock after the write.
SAT_COUNT counts the outputs that saturated since CLEAR.
SAMPLES_DONE counts the samples processed since CLEAR.
sfp_tx_disable is driven to 1 at all times.
The design uses no GT transceiver channel.
data/jtag_bus.sv is used unchanged.
The design clock input is the 25 MHz board clock on pin C3.
